pages.text: Kill the $(t4)Ender Dragon$() first — the Ad Astra planets are the $(bold)post-game$(), and they open only after the pack's finale.$(br2)Then you need three things: a $(bold)Rocket Workbench$(), a $(bold)rocket$(), and $(bold)fuel$() — none of them cheap, all built on established Tier 4 infrastructure.

$(bold)Rocket Workbench$()$(br)The gateway item. Crafted from Netherite, Mekanism Steel Casings, and a Reality Progression Token (a Tier 4 crafting token). Without this station, no rockets can be built.$(br2)$(bold)Fuel Refining$()$(br)Ad Astra fuel requires RF-powered refining. You will need $(italic)significant$() power infrastructure — a coal generator will not cut it. Bring your Mekanism Fusion Reactor or Thermal Dynamos.

$(bold)Oxygen$()$(br)Space has no oxygen. You need an $(bold)Oxygen Loader$() to fill your space suit before launch, and oxygen tanks for extended stays. The Oxygen Loader requires continuous RF power.$(br2)$(bold)RF Requirements$()$(br)All Ad Astra machines consume significantly more RF than default. This is intentional — bringing proper power infrastructure to space is part of the challenge.

$(bold)Water-to-Fuel Processing$()$(br)Transport water to your planetary base via $(bold)Dynamic Tank$() on your rocket. Then process it through Mekanism machines:$(br2)1. $(bold)Electrolytic Separator$(): Water → Hydrogen + Oxygen$(br)2. $(bold)Rotary Condensentrator$(): Hydrogen → Rocket Fuel$(br2)This two-step chain means real Mekanism infrastructure investment pays off in space. The oxygen byproduct also feeds your base's life support.

$(bold)Planetary Enchantments$()$(br)Each planet's mobs drop unique enchanted books (12% chance) that protect against that planet's hazards:$(br)• $(bold)Moon$() → Lunar Stride$(br)• $(bold)Mars$() → Thermal Regulation$(br)• $(bold)Mercury$() → Stellar Shield$(br)• $(bold)Venus$() → Pressure Shell$(br)• $(bold)Glacio$() → Void Adaptation$(br2)Collect these on early planets to survive later ones.
